note: The oscal-mapping-oscal-mapping-common:mapping-resource-reference definition from the OSCAL 1.2.1 mapping-collection model, demonstrating that a mapped resource reference requires type and href and constrains type with an open anyOf vocabulary whose enumeration lists catalog and profile.
constraints: type uses anyOf (open vocabulary) with enum ["catalog","profile"]

fragment.title: Mapped Resource Reference
fragment.description: A reference to a resource that is either the source or the target of a mapping.

ns.title: Resource Type Namespace
ns.description: An optional namespace qualifying the resource's type.

type.title: Resource Type
type.description: The semantic type of the resource.

href.title: Catalog or Profile Reference
href.description: A resolvable URL reference to the base catalog or profile that this profile is tailoring.
